findings: Verified exact 28-path candidate against baseCommit 2c2b9182a2a756ce3b722d1a2bcfa6a31014c901 and prospectiveTree 23a78098cbdf690ac3b6f9a994f6d5033b869b18, with root Cargo.toml (91e489de70caf1cd51fa77169a269617e402bca14f47f7c5cbd0bfe6e11b7c76) and Cargo.lock (659ca9ca7df02e4ff4e3c2b424fa2d6b95d73e596fdf85d0046df423ced4dbb5) unchanged.

Verified feature closure in crates/mori/Cargo.toml: default = ["native"], with mori-backend, mori-ledger, futures, rand, and all eight formerly unconditional Midnight dev-dependencies moved to optional normal dependencies under native so that -p mori --no-default-features excludes all Midnight/backend/ledger crates from the selected dependency graph while retaining unconditional k256 in mori-core for legacy Core intents.

Verified full clap command/flag/conflict/required schema retention in crates/mori/src/cli.rs and dispatch in crates/mori/src/commands/mod.rs; native_unavailable() constructs CliError::Operation { code: "mori::command::native-unavailable", message: "This mori build has no Midnight support. Rebuild with the native feature enabled." }, which main.rs reports to stderr and exits 1 (while clap parse/conflict errors exit 2 before dispatch).

Verified all 13 native-only command modules (compile, compile_call, keygen_call, keygen_signed_call, prepare_call, prepare_signed_call, prove, prove_call, prove_signed_call, replay, verify, verify_call, verify_signed_call) and shared I/O modules (call_io, proof_io, signed_call_io, core_io) gate all native imports, helpers, types, and unit tests behind #[cfg(feature = "native")] / #[cfg(all(test, feature = "native"))], retain original native function bodies (103 literal function regions preserved), and refuse in #[cfg(not(feature = "native"))] via super::native_unavailable() without reading or writing any paths or falling back to Core.

Verified mixed-command precedence: (1) inspect --target under not(feature = "native") refuses with native_unavailable() at the top of inspect::run before reading source or target (including for moriarty/2 sources), while preserving source-only inspect for /1 and /2 and preserving native /2 profile refusal before target read when native is enabled; (2) simulate --trace validates --target presence first (--trace requires --target) in both configurations, then under not(feature = "native") returns native_unavailable() before reading target/authority/source/scenario, while preserving --target/authorization-without-trace refusal and Core /1, metered /1, and /2 start/resume; (3) intent checks --profile vs legacy conflicts first, then inside signed() enforces "--profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1 requires --target and --at together" before returning native_unavailable() under not(feature = "native"); (4) verify-intent enforces --profile and --target group matching in run() before calling signed(), which immediately returns native_unavailable() under not(feature = "native").

Verified test target gating: all 11 native-only integration targets require feature "native" in crates/mori/Cargo.toml, and mixed targets core_continuations.rs and fee_pool_component.rs gate only their native compile/trace/targeted-inspect/static-compile tests and helpers behind #[cfg(feature = "native")].

Verified narrow Rust guideline exceptions in RUST_GUIDELINES.md and plugins/moriarty-dev/skills/develop/references/rust.md permitting real CLI binary tests for public dispatch, feature availability, frozen complete output, exits, and I/O (without --help snapshots and without treating shared-evaluator comparisons as independent oracles), while explicitly recording existing external fixture paths and #[path] test-support mounts as separate unclosed deviations.

Explicitly agree to and approve the single proposed ordinary command and resource bound in PROPOSAL.json: 1 attempt, 90s wall clock + 5s TERM/KILL grace, -j1, --test-threads=1, --frozen, -p mori --no-default-features selecting only stage_test_public (2 functions), core_test_report (6 functions), and logical_meter (4 functions), with fresh owned cwd/CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR/TMPDIR under /tmp/doctorwatson-cli-core-check-, the exact 13-variable environment whitelist (offline, non-incremental, no HOME, no inherited vars, no capture hooks), 4 pinned tool SHA-256 checks, and 14 ancestor Cargo config absence checks.
limitations: Source and static substring preservation checks only; no Rust build, clippy, formatting, or runtime test execution has been performed yet, and fresh independent reviews of actual execution results are required before merge.
Default and explicit native CLI builds and test targets remain a separate unrun matrix and are not established by a no-default Core CLI build or test run.
The new security-authored native_feature_boundary test target is a separate pending source increment excluded from this 28-path candidate and from this single command.

stage_test_public contains 2 test functions against the blinded R3 freeze (ad44178b801dc51bfa6e254a2d9b48c18a4f7ea99e7b919be75730dc761cc34d) and zero strict-manifest test cases; R3 blinding premises and all 14 normative gaps (GAP01-GAP14) remain open.

core_test_report pins the independent normal transfer freeze (3911ef8990bbcdf067f641bcae032f48828b2035ddae55f8687969ecc0cb2395) and small stdout digest (b57043f1d8fd55e80cfde729ef8e85f78225ff29129bc8da6696c7f1163e5118), while its 87 accepted FeePool rows assert full expected post-state and ordered effects only (not full pre-state, step-by-step execution, or per-action logical work).

logical_meter derives its full execution and legacy byte comparisons from the shared mori_core evaluator and prior unmetered CLI output (compatibility evidence, not an independent full-execution oracle), and its fourth function checks --logical-cap/--trace clap conflict refusal before any file read without exercising trace generation.

The 90s + 5s kill-grace budget is a scoped cold-build resource decision for this single ordinary no-default CLI attempt only; consumed 30s Core-only admissions are not reused, all historical native/resource caps and counters (including C4/k17) remain in force, no aggregate child RAM/disk/process-group enforcement is claimed, and local toolchain/linker/public Cargo caches/build scripts/proc macros remain stated TCB assumptions.

This increment does not close Issue #81, any U0-U7, M1-M17, MC01-MC08, SP01-SP12, or G01-G24 gate, compiler-to-ZKIR correspondence, native proof/key/ledger qualification, or Preview/stagenet/Fenrir target acceptance.
